quest.title: The Frozen, Rekindling Land
quest.description: You finally enter the volcano, only to find pitch darkness all around. Continue exploring this place...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Chosen One, Chosen of Dragons...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Traverse the eternal city. Venture into the Heart of the Sacred Mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Banish... the great enemy cloaked in shadow. Ignite... the frigid embers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *cough* H—How's everyone? Still okay?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rroooh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is your head okay? After all, you did fall from really high up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're not hurt, are you?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm, you seem fine. What about you, {NICKNAME}? Are you okay?

choices.text: Well, I certainly look like I'm in one piece...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pfft, "in one piece"? Are you serious? *sigh* Paimon's just glad you're not hurt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still... Who'd have thought there'd be such a huge space underneath this volcano? It's super dark here, though...

choices.text: Time for you to shine, Paimon! Give us some light!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, no problem, let Paimon just go ahead and... AS IF! Paimon's no glow-in-the-dark pixie! There's nothing here to work with, fire's the only way we're getting any light!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's just... explore the area a bit first, okay?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh, just keep assuming we have one — maybe one might even magically manifest itself...

choices.text: I was so scared, something leaked out... Seen any bits of my soul floating around?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ha-ha, very funny! If you can joke like that, you must be feeling absolutely peachy!

talks.objective: Follow the path as it lights up

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrooh!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: *whirr-click*...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "It seems you have finally restored the two Astral Assemblages to normal operation... Soon, the phlogiston concentration here should be sufficient to reactivate the communications device..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "In the meantime, please wait a little longer. You have already done well, for a human."

choices.text: Wait, we're back to talking again?

response.speaker: Secret Source Servant
response.text: "I am not. Ehecatl's existence has dissipated in full... not long ago, in fact. And though names matter little here, the name left to this body is..."

response.speaker: Secret Source Servant
response.text: "'Almighty Amaru, the Hallowed Lord'... *sigh* The original bearer of this name was a fool through and through."

response.speaker: Amaru
response.text: "You may simply name it 'Amaru.'"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Amaru?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrawr?

response.speaker: Amaru
response.text: "In life, he was arrogant, unrestrained in speech, brainless, and aggravating... But in the war, he held the threshold of the sealed Celestial Axis until his final breath..."

response.speaker: Amaru
response.text: "This is that very spot, and that is why I placed the Secret Source Servant who once waited on him here... It is happy to guard the Axis in its master's place, or so I imagine."

response.speaker: Amaru
response.text: Increase in phlogiston concentration detected... Circuit check complete... *whirring*

response.speaker: Amaru
response.text: Lift shaft — Celestial Axis, restarted.

response.speaker: Amaru
response.text: "It appears we are almost done. Please proceed deeper within."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm? {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? What's up? Found something?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Whrooawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. This... is the statue that Qucusaur had. So it dropped down here as well...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Y'know, it kinda looks like you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, but with big ears, and rolled into a ball.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? You don't think so? Paimon sure does...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! It's moving!
*whirr*...*click*...
Self-diagnostic in progress... Moderate dust accumulation in joints... Storage medium activated... Speech... remote extraction... Override permitted... *clicking*... Personality module correction...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so this was some kinda mechanism, not a statue... Well, it does look like those Source Mechanisms. And that strange light floating around it... Feels like we've seen that before somewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why has it stopped moving?
"Warggh!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaahhh!
"Ah. It seems my voice module works. Well then, honored guests. I have awaited you for a long... Sorry, is something the matter?"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you have to suddenly make that loud noise? You scared Paimon to death!
"Did I? Then that is well. A dynamic entrance is the only way to leave a lasting impression. Otherwise, I'd worry that you might feel I was neglecting you..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err, sorry. Who are you again?
"Who am I, you say? Well, this body's name is Ehecatl, and you may so call it, but such things as names hold little meaning here..."
Individual designation modification request... Via records... 150 years after the war... Designation changed to one from a list of the fallen — Ehecatl.

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Yes, indeed. Since then, this body has been named Ehecatl..."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Yes, it was I who called you here. Come, let us go unto the Heart of the Sacred Mountain... before it is too late."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "That said, we are not yet in a hurry. Let Ehecatl clear away at least some smidgen of the darkness that lies before you. I know you must have your doubts, but please, follow me for now."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "I should explain that this place was not always so dark... Even though it is undoubtedly the 'inside' of a volcano..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "However, after the war was over, the entire city was destroyed. After that, such a huge mechanical construct could hardly continue to function..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: War?

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Yes, the war between the remaining Dragonborn and the humans — the war in which the original master of flame was killed..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "The master of this place is long since dead, and naught else but the city ekes out survival... Though who can really say? Perhaps the city, too, has already ceased to live."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "...Hmm. Or perhaps so many things that once existed were nothing more than illusions."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "We each stand to benefit, little one. You get what you came for, and I hope to borrow your power to solve a few problems of my own..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "And so, you must reach the Heart of the Sacred Mountain... But alas, the Mountain's power was cut off during the war."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "And for all that the seals' power is like weak threads that could only entrap a whelp, the oath dictates that only a 'human' may activate them..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "In an interesting twist, the poor child who used this method to infiltrate the Sacred Mountain was, in the end, brought to ruin by someone else using nigh identical means."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Hehe. Ah, such has it ever been... Just as the followers of a tyrant are driven out by heroes, and after many years of wandering, their descendants end tyranny in some other realm..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "The world and its affairs are akin to a staged play. Cause and effect, revenge and revolt... All scenes repeat themselves one after the other across ragged eons..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Ah, but I am getting off-topic... Well then. Activate it, and let this moribund capital writhe a little while longer. None but you is worthy to do this deed now."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ehrr...Rroo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong? You don't look like you're doing so hot...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawrgh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that... the Abyss?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Indeed... Abyssal creatures invade the Sacred City of Tollan like an irremediable pestilence."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "At this point, it may even be impossible to contain their march completely without bringing the Sacred Mountain itself down around us..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you discover one Abyssal creature...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Then perhaps your home is already completely infested with those stygian, viscid villains..."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, why do you guys have to be so creepy about it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll chop their legs off — that'll put a stop to any marching they might do!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, how very wise and insightful, now all we need to do is find their legs... Ha! As if Paimon could say that with a straight face!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Haha. 'Tis a shame, little one, but I fear most Abyssal creatures may not need legs for locomotion."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "...Only by destroying the shadowy foe that bars our path may you pass through this place and reach the Sacred Mountain's heart."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Nothing can be done now to restore the glory this ravaged city had of old, but neither should its carcass be left to the tender mercies of these dark monsters."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, don't you have those big fireballs...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. Don't you use them to fight the Abyss?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Fireballs... You mean the Astral Assemblages? Nay, they may only trigger mutual annihilation on contact with the Abyss. Otherwise, they will instead be corrupted and enveloped by the dark..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Alas, this city has been sealed off for too long... And the Astral Assemblages have been prevented from moving freely to maintain its stability..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "O Chosen of Dragons..."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "The Heart of the Sacred Mountain was re-excavated after Tollan was established... and the first Secret Source Dragon Idol stands guard over it."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "You must obtain a permit to gain access to the Heart..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "But the power source of the Idol has also been corrupted. We must find some way to reactivate it..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "They..." Warning. Functions damaged. Shutdown imminent... "Ah, looks like this machine is..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Amaru? Hey, Amaru! What permit? C'mon, you'd barely started talking!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Heh... Keep pressing on. A new Secret Source Servant shall guide you there..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: *whirr-click*...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "This is the map of the Sacred City's core. I will... await you at..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, and the light's gone out again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess this "Amaru" guy isn't gonna be talking to us anymore, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He really just does whatever he feels like, huh... Not much we can do but forge ahead and see if we can't rustle up a new Secret Source Servant...

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Have I officially given you its name, by the by? I believe I have not..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "No matter. Welcome to the first Sacred Ci{RUBY#[D]Land of Primal Flame}ty, Tollan."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... Paimon was not expecting the volcano to look like this on the inside...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that really where we are? Or did we get yoinked to a different spot when we went through the volcano's mouth?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrah... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Oh, this is undoubtedly the Sacred Mountain's interior, but even I... know not how long it has been since I saw such a sight..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Ah... Only when the light shone upon you once more, did I see that you had mouldered so..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehecatl?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Ah, my apologies. Mere brief indulgence in unnecessary sentimentality..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: Energy reserve low... Hibernation imminent. Please replace or connect... energy storage medium...

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Haha. It seems like dear Ehecatl's long 'exile' has left it with little time..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what do you mean? Is Ehecatl... gonna die?

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "The one you name Ehecatl has long ceased to be amongst the living... To be brief, Tollan requires a great amount of energy to be restarted, and no waste can be permitted. You must..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Destroy the seal on one of the other two 'Astral As{RUBY#[D]Tzitzimimeh}semblages'... and the other... Only then can you truly activate the Celestial Axis in the center..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "Uhhh..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You alright over there?

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "...I am fine. We will... meet again..."

dialogues.speaker: Ehecatl
dialogues.text: "*sigh* ... Onward then, Chosen of Dragons... Alas, the pain of a body losing its vitality... I am not used to it... even after all these years..."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The light around Ehecatl's gone... It's not moving anymore, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's still kinda confused... Was that really Ehecatl talking, or was someone else speaking through it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True. Still, about the Astral Assemblages he mentioned just now... Does he mean something like that big fireball from earlier? And what's this Celestial Axis thing? We don't have any idea what that is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh well, let's take a look around and see if we can find those strange things he mentioned!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Scanning... This location... The path to the Celestial Axis has been sealed. Core Astral Assemblage has been activated...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Remaining Astral Assemblages must be re-stabilized to gain the power needed to reopen the seal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, Ehecatl?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Scanning... This location... The path to the Celestial Axis has been sealed. Core Astral Assemblage has been activated...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Remaining Astral Assemblages must be re-stabilized to gain the power needed to reopen the seal...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rroo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, this isn't Ehecatl. Even if they do look the same...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, the "Celestial Axis"... This has gotta be the one that Ehecatl said needed activating, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we'll have to look around for the other two Astral Assemblages, then!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Scanning... This location... The path to the Celestial Axis has been sealed. Core Astral Assemblage has been activated...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Re-stabilize the Astral Assemblages to initiate the opening of the path ahead...

talks.objective: Head to the depths of the ancient city

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Increase in phlogiston concentration detected... Circuit check complete... *whirring*

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Lift shaft — Celestial Pillar, restarted.

talks.objective: Head to the depths of the ancient city

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like we're done with the two "Astral Assemblages" that strange statue was talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's head over to that "Celestial Axis" thingamajig in the middle and check things out!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!
